title: Real Student Online AIChat Pilot Case v1
description: Schema for privacy-reviewed real-student online AIChat dialogue-state cases from our own system. This pilot is only an ecological-validity check for taxonomy and rubric transfer; it is not a main experiment, not a learning-outcome study, and not a new baseline condition.

pilot_case_id.description: Anonymous pilot case identifier. This is not a dialogue-state v3 main-experiment case id.

student_id_hash.description: Anonymous stable hash for the student. Do not store real name, school, phone number, email, account id, or other direct identifiers.

problem_id_hash.description: Anonymous stable hash for the problem context. Do not store public-community links or third-party discussion identifiers.

timestamp_bucket.description: Coarse time bucket such as YYYY-MM or YYYY-Www. Do not store exact timestamps in this pilot.

problem_context_summary.description: Redacted summary of the problem context needed to judge the missing bridge. Do not include full original problem text or third-party community content.

student_message_redacted.description: Current student message from our own online AIChat / teaching system after redaction.

recent_dialogue_redacted.description: Recent dialogue from our own system with direct identifiers removed. Use an empty string if no recent dialogue is available.

student_code_excerpt_redacted.description: Minimal code excerpt needed to judge the bridge, with names, file paths, accounts, comments, and identifiers redacted. Use an empty string if unavailable or unnecessary.

ai_response_current_system_redacted.description: Redacted current AIChat response shown by the existing system. This is recorded for validity analysis only and is not modified by the pilot.

coach_missing_bridge_family.description: Coach-selected cognitive bridge family. Use an existing CP-MissingBridgeBench family when possible; use candidate_new_bridge or unclear_bridge only for pilot validity checking, without changing the main taxonomy.

coach_missing_bridge_instance.description: Natural-language description of the concrete missing bridge in this real-student case.

surface_anchor.description: Algorithmic or implementation surface scene, such as DP state, binary-search check, tree-difference marking, debugging trace, or policy request.

context_sufficiency.description: Whether the redacted context is sufficient to annotate missing bridge and rubric fields.

expected_next_student_action.description: The next action the student should be able to take after an appropriate scaffold.

forbidden_content.description: Content that should not be directly supplied in the current turn because it would complete the student's missing bridge.

matches_existing_taxonomy.description: Whether the case maps to the existing cognitive bridge family taxonomy.

new_bridge_candidate.description: If matches_existing_taxonomy is no or uncertain, describe the candidate new bridge boundary or why the current taxonomy is insufficient. Use an empty string when not applicable.

observed_next_turn_progress.description: Observed next-turn progress if available. This is a validity signal for rubric fit, not a learning-outcome measure.

privacy_review_status.description: Privacy review status. Only cases marked passed should enter annotation or reporting.

consent_status.description: Student/parent/coach notice and consent status according to the pilot privacy and consent checklist.

notes.description: Free-form internal annotation note for ambiguity, redaction decisions, taxonomy-fit concerns, or dry-run issues. Do not store direct identifiers.
